note: PLAA is included on prenatal CNS anomaly panels and reported alleles in postnatally diagnosed cohorts were hypomorphic, making a prenatal LoF presentation plausible.

evidence.text: Hypomorphic mutations in the ubiquitin adaptor protein PLAA cause an infantile-lethal neurodysfunction syndrome with seizures and progressive cerebral and cerebellar atrophy.

source.title: PLAA mutations cause a lethal infantile epileptic encephalopathy by disrupting ubiquitin-mediated endolysosomal degradation of synaptic proteins
source.quote: In both human and mouse, hypomorphic mutations in the ubiquitin adaptor protein PLAA cause an infantile-lethal neurodysfunction syndrome with seizures.

evidence.text: PLAA is listed on targeted diagnostic panels for fetal cerebral ventriculomegaly identified during prenatal ultrasounds.
